title: doctor FAILs a pre-contract brew keg on the switch and tree rows, where T3 says it is a note naming brew upgrade
body:
## What happened

Ccusage's adoption of 0326 (reported by ccusage-dc, relayed by vc, 2026-11-13) found that devbin 0.1.23's doctor FAILs a pre-contract brew keg on two rows. docs/dev-opt-brew.md's T3 says such a keg is "a note naming `brew upgrade <tool>`, never a failure", because the release that writes the new form is cut by a run of doctor on a machine still holding the old keg. Ccusage's 0.1.9 cut is red on hv's Mac for this reason, and it blocks that cut.

- **(a) The switch row, with no link.** Ccusage 0.1.8's keg has its bin link resolve to `libexec/ccusage`, not `libexec/bin/ccusage`. tool_brew_answer_state (lib/helpers, around 5859) does not read that as the keg's launcher, answers `other`, and tool_brew_path_why (around 5947) tells the user to move `/opt/homebrew/bin/ccusage` aside, which is Homebrew's own link.
- **(b) The tree row.** The keg's manifest has no `# line:`. doctor checks the manifest's body first and fails "does not match its manifest" with "missing: LICENSE, README.md" (see 0349 for why those files are gone), and only after that gives its own note that the manifest is the old form (lib/cmd/doctor 1376-1404).

## Why it matters

Every adopter's first release under the contract is cut on a machine that holds its old keg, so every adopter whose old keg has either shape hits a red cut it cannot fix except by releasing.

## Not yet known

Whether an older keg's other layouts (a link into libexec at another depth) reach `other` too, and whether the old-form check should come before the body check, or the body's failures become notes for an old-form keg.

## Options, none chosen

- Read a keg with no `# line:` as the old form before checking its body, and give the body's findings as notes, never failures, for a brew keg.
- Recognise a link that resolves anywhere under the keg's libexec as the keg's, for an old-form keg.

## Resolution

Fixed in two units landed on main on 2026-11-13 at 09:45Z: 0348-1 at 46270faf36f03ec5bb51762d7f8fb965a109df03 and 0348-2 at 4f3c797bcf8d62e603f9ace274fd58e3f2bf1c01. They were tested together at the tip 47cc47df and rebased onto main with the same changed lines. They are in devbin 0.1.24's batch and stay unpushed until devbin's next cut. Each was proved on its own arms on devbin-vc's desk: red at its parent's code, green at the fix. The six test files that drive the changed code were run whole at the tip under BSD.

- (a) The switch row. tool_is_install_launcher (lib/helpers) still matches `<root>/bin/<link>` for every tree, but no longer gives up when that file is missing. For a keg's libexec, a hit that resolves (real_path, getcwd mode) to what the keg's own `bin/<link>` resolves to is the launcher. That one rule covers the Linux link, the macOS env script and the older link to `libexec/<link>`, so Homebrew's own link is no longer named another copy to move aside. tool_brew_launcher_inert reads its second hop only behind the env script, so the older keg is not read as one that would not run. `use brew` and a bare `use` read the same answer, so they are fixed too. The open question in "Not yet known" is answered by the same rule: a link into libexec at any depth is the keg's when the keg's own `bin/<link>` leads there.
- (b) The tree row. _check_tool_tree (lib/cmd/doctor) reads the manifest's form before its body. If the manifest is there and readable but holds no line, a brew keg gets the note naming brew upgrade, an opt install gets the FAIL naming the republish, and neither body is read, as T3 has it. The output changes in one place: an opt install in the older form no longer lists its body drift under its FAIL. 0.1.24's note says so.

Of the two options the issue named, the first is taken for (b) and the second, generalised, for (a). The keg builder gained `brew_keg --flat`, the older layout, and three arms in tool.bats hold it: the Homebrew answer for that keg, doctor's switch row and `use brew` on it, and its tree row with an opt control. The 0348-1 red reproduced the reported line ("which is not Homebrew's demo-cli ... move aside"), and the 0348-2 red reproduced "missing: LICENSE" ahead of the old-form note. The whole-file run at the tip had one red, helpers.bats arm 47, which is red at the base and on main from 0346-1's lib/bats-lanes mv line, and dc has it as a unit of its own. 0.1.24's note carries 0348 under Fixed.
